name: yss-mvc-scaffold-generator
description: Create YSS Java 8 MVC backend projects and restore their external MVC skillUtils environment.

interface.shortDescription: 创建 MVC 后端项目或恢复克隆项目的配套环境。
interface.longDescription: Create an independent YSS Java 8 MVC data-analysis project with six Maven modules, Oracle or OceanBase Oracle configuration, optional Mock execution, lifecycle documents, shared skills, and verification seams. Initialization is atomic and never downloads Maven dependencies; dependency resolution is deferred to explicit verification.
defaultPrompt: 初始化一个 YSS Oracle 数据分析项目
用 Mock 模式创建数据分析项目骨架
检查 YSS 数据分析项目初始化参数
为已克隆的 MVC 后端项目恢复相邻 skillUtils
